name: Crunchy Chicken & Black Bean Tacos with Mango-Jalapẽno Slaw (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until just softened, 2-3 minutes.
When the onion is just softened, add beans, water, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are warmed through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp chili powder
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp oregano, dried
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave.
When the beans are done, transfer to a medium bowl and crush with a potato masher to create a semi-smooth mixture. (Wipe skillet clean with paper towels and set aside for later use.)

Place softened tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the chicken and cheese between them, arranging the filling on one side. Fold 3 of the tortillas in half to close. Divide bean mixture between remaining tortillas, fold in half to close, and gently press to adhere.
instructions.secondary_message:
227 g cooked chicken (shredded)
2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tacos to the skillet and pan-fry, flipping once, until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden and crispy on both sides, 7-8 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lime
1 mango
½ small bunch cilantro
½ jalapeño pepper

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lime into a clean medium bowl. Add mayo, honey, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing. Add shredded cabbage, stir to combine the coleslaw, then transfer 1 cup to a plate. (Reserve remaining coleslaw for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
2 tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
1 (397 g) bag shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)

instructions.primary_message: Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Thinly slice half of the mango flesh, add to the plate with the coleslaw, and set aside. Small dice remaining mango and add to the bowl with the remaining coleslaw.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice, add to the bowl, and toss to combine the mango-jalapeño slaw. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

FOR THE KIDS PLATES: Cut chicken and cheese tacos in half and divide between plates. Serve with plain coleslaw, mango slices, and sour cream for dipping. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining whole chicken-black bean tacos and mango-jalapeño slaw between plates. Serve with sour cream for dipping and enjoy!
